'''Heron Jorael''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Jorael was a Human of average height with [[brown]] hair and tan skin.
